overview.title: 考情总览
overview.lead: 每格代表 10% 的试卷；教材进度加粗，表示考查早于教学。
overview.after: 时态、被动语态每卷都考，初中已学，见同步讲义，本册不单列。

topics.name: 非谓语

explain.text: 作宾语与搭配
动词或介词后面接什么形式，看前面那个词。look forward to、spend time、be busy、quit 后面用 doing；pretend、need、be about to 后面用 to do。
look forward to 的 to 是介词，后面接 doing，不接动词原形。题目多半给固定搭配，熟悉搭配即可定形式。
look forward to doing  |  spend time doing  |  pretend to do
作宾补
find、make 之后，若宾语是动作的承受者，宾补用过去分词（found herself left alone、make myself understood）。
that 从句若是「宾语 + 被动」，可改成「宾语 + 过去分词」，如 found that his wallet was stolen → found his wallet stolen。
作主语
动名词短语作主语，整个短语看作单数，谓语用单数。句首的 doing 首字母大写，如 Taking、Holding、Being。
作状语、作定语各 2 题，不单列：Compared with…（过去分词作状语）、a lot to explore（不定式作后置定语）各举一例。

topics.keypoint: 空前的词决定形式：介词 to、spend、be busy、quit 后用 doing；pretend、need、be about to 后用 to do。动作与逻辑主语是被动关系时用 done。

gloss: 介词 to 后用 doing

stem.text: I am looking forward to ___ (explore) the world of literature with you.
stem.src: 2024 · 东莞市 · 高一上联考

examples.ju: 我期待着和你一起探索文学的世界。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: look forward to 的 to 是介词，其后用 explore 的动名词 exploring 作宾语。

stem.text: My spoken English is so poor that I cannot make myself ___ (understand).
stem.src: 2023 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: 我的英语口语很差，以至于不能让别人听懂我的话。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: make 之后 myself 是宾语，understand 与之是被动关系，作宾补，用过去分词。

stem.text: ___ (hold) the 29th Olympics successfully shows the power of our nation.
stem.src: 2022 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: 成功举办第29届奥运会显示了我们国家的力量。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: Holding the 29th Olympics 是动名词短语作主语，句首用 doing；谓语 shows 用单数。

drill.stem: Steve has expressed the hope that he is looking forward to ___ (hear) from you soon.
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞实验 · 高一上月考
drill.why: look forward to 的 to 是介词，接 doing。

drill.stem: At the weekends, I play computer games if I’m not busy ___ (study).
drill.src: 2024 · 光正实验 · 高一上月考
drill.why: be busy doing sth. 是固定用法。

drill.stem: Something about the song made me feel powerful, and I even started to daydream about ___ (报名) the concert and finally getting the chance to surprise everyone with my secret.
drill.src: 2023 · 东华、东华松山湖 · 高一上月考
drill.why: about 是介词，后接动名词；sign up for 报名。

drill.stem: In the middle of the crowded city, she suddenly found herself ___ (leave) alone, feeling small and out of place.
drill.src: 2024 · 东莞市 · 高一上月考
drill.why: found 之后宾补与宾语是被动，用过去分词。

drill.stem:
After he got off the bus, he found that his wallet was stolen.
After getting off the bus, he found ___.
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞实验 · 高一上月考
drill.ans: After getting off the bus, he found his wallet stolen.
drill.why: that 从句的被动可改成「宾语 + 过去分词」。

drill.stem: What is important for keeping healthy is being happy.
drill.src: 2023 · 石竹实验 · 高一上月考
drill.ans: Being happy is important for keeping healthy.
drill.why: 句首 Being happy 作主语，谓语用单数。

drill.stem: 我喜欢做运动而不喜欢在家待着。
drill.src: 2024 · 麻涌中学 · 高一上月考
drill.ans: I prefer playing sports to staying at home.
drill.why: prefer A to B：喜欢做 A 而不是做 B。

drill.stem: The lecture ___ (organize) by our university to promote Chinese traditional culture is a big success.
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上月考
drill.why: 讲座与 organize 是被动，后置定语用过去分词。

topics.name: it 形式主宾语

explain.text: 形式宾语
find、think、make 等动词后面，宾语位置如果是 it，真正的宾语是后面的不定式或从句。结构是 find / make + it + 形容词 + to do。
判断：空格前是这类动词，后面紧跟形容词，再接 to do，就填 it，如 I don’t think it possible to finish…。
find it adj. to do  |  make it adj. for sb. to do
形式主语
句首的 it 作形式主语，真正的主语是句末的不定式或 that 从句，常见 It is obvious / clear / important that…。
改写时：Obviously 这类副词改成 It is obvious that…；动名词主语（Spending…）改成 It is 形容词 to do…，主语挪到句末。

topics.keypoint: 空格在 find、think、make 之后，且后面是形容词加 to do，填 it；句首的 it 是形式主语，真正的主语在句末。

stem.text: I don’t think ___ possible to finish so much work in such a short time.
stem.src: 2024 · 光正实验 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: 我认为在这么短的时间内完成这么多工作是不可能的。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: think 后的 it 是形式宾语，真正的宾语是 to finish so much work。

stem.text: Spending too much time online is unhealthy.

examples.ju: 在网上花太多时间是不健康的。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: 动名词短语作主语时，句首改用 it，把主语挪到句末，用 to do。

examples.ans: It is unhealthy to spend too much time online

drill.stem: The young woman found ___ difficult to learn a second language at university.
drill.src: 2023 · 翰林 · 高一月考
drill.why: find it + 形容词 + to do。

drill.stem: The injury in her leg makes ___ impossible for her to return to track and field.
drill.src: 2022 · 莞中松山湖 · 高一上月考
drill.why: make it + 形容词 + for sb. to do。

drill.stem: You will find that it is helpful to join in some extra-curricular activities.
cue: 用it作形式宾语改写句子
drill.src: 2024 · 东莞高中 · 高一上月考
drill.ans: You will find it helpful to join in some extra-curricular activities.
drill.why: that 从句改为 find it + 形容词 + to do。

drill.stem: ___ is obvious that our earth is suffering serious damage because of improper (不恰当的) human activities.
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上月考
drill.why: It is obvious that 句型，it 作形式主语。

drill.stem: 保护环境是我们的责任。
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞实验 · 高一上月考
drill.ans: It is our responsibility to protect the environment.
drill.why: It is 名词 to do：不定式作真正主语。

topics.name: 虚拟语气

explain.text: recommend 型
recommend、suggest、insist、request 等动词后的宾语从句，或 It is recommended that… 的主语从句，从句谓语用 (should) + 动词原形。段考里几乎只考这一种。
从句主语若是动作的承受者，套被动：(should) be done。should 可省，答案两种都给分；但 be 不能丢。What if 型只有 1 题，见例 2。
recommend that sb. (should) do  |  It is recommended that sth. (should) be done

topics.keypoint: 见 recommend、request 等后的 that 从句，谓语写 (should) + 动词原形；主语是物再加 be done。把 recommend sb. to do 改成从句时，写成 recommend that sb. (should) do。

stem.text: It is highly recommended that the government ___ (take) measures to protect the environment.
stem.src: 2023 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: 强烈建议政府采取措施保护环境。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: 主句是 It is recommended，that 从句作真正的主语，从句用 (should) + 动词原形。

stem.text:
What would happen if we didn’t get there on time?
___ we didn’t get there on time?
stem.src: 2024 · 东莞高中 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: 如果我们没有按时到达那里会发生什么？

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: 原句是对过去事实的虚拟条件句，改写成固定句型 What if…。

drill.stem: Mrs Brown 建议我积极参加课外活动。
drill.src: 2023 · 石竹实验 · 高一上月考
drill.ans: Mrs Brown recommended that I (should) take part in after-class activities actively.
drill.why: recommend 后从句用 (should) + 动词原形。

drill.stem: It is strongly recommended that the machines ___ (check) every year.
drill.src: 2024 · 东莞高中 · 高一上月考
drill.why: machines 被检查，用 be checked。

drill.stem: The doctor recommended that my brother ___ (give) up smoking.
drill.src: 2020 · 东华 · 高一上期中
drill.why: should 可省，give 不能丢。

drill.stem: Mary likes dancing and her adviser recommended she ___ (报名) a ballet course.
drill.src: 2023 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.why: recommend 后从句用 should 原形。

drill.stem: Our teachers request that attention ___ (focus) on the lessons in class.
drill.src: 2022 · 东莞实验 · 高一上期中
drill.why: request 同 recommend，从句虚拟。

topics.name: 名词性从句

explain.text: 作宾语
宾语从句看从句缺不缺成分：缺主语或宾语，用 what、which、who 等连接代词；成分齐全，用 that（可省）、whether 或 if。
例：tells them ___ happened on the ship，happened 前缺主语，填 what。句意完整的宾语从句，that 可省。
作主语

lines: 多以 It is obvious that

explain.text: 主语从句常以 It is 形容词 that 的形式出现：it 是形式主语，that 从句是真正的主语，that 不能省。
这类句子和上一专题的 it 形式主语是同一句型，判断方法相同：找到 it，再看句末的 that 从句。表语、同位语从句本册没有题，不讲。

topics.keypoint: 宾语从句看从句缺不缺成分，缺就用 what、which、who，不缺用 that（可省）、whether 或 if。主语从句多是 It is adj. that，that 不能省。

stem.text: Tim writes his parents an email every week and tells them ___ happened on the ship.
stem.src: 2024 · 光正实验 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: Tim 每周给父母写一封电子邮件，告诉他们船上发生的事情。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: what 引导宾语从句，在从句中作主语，happened 前缺主语。

stem.text:
Obviously, keeping a balanced diet is of great importance.
___ keeping a balanced diet is of great importance.

examples.ju: 很显然，保持均衡饮食很重要。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: it 是形式主语，that 从句是真正的主语。

examples.ans: It is obvious that keeping a balanced diet is of great importance

drill.stem: First, Adam had to think very carefully about ___ courses he wanted to take.
drill.src: 2025 · 嘉荣外国语 · 高一上月考
drill.why: which 修饰 courses，引导宾语从句。

drill.stem: It is obvious ___ technology is changing the way we live and work.
drill.src: 2024 · 麻涌中学 · 高一上月考
drill.why: It is obvious that 中的 that 不能省。

drill.stem: 老师建议我们不要沉迷于玩电脑游戏。
drill.src: 2023 · 翰林 · 高一月考
drill.ans: The teacher recommended that we should not be addicted to playing computer games.
drill.why: 宾语从句用 that 引导，从句谓语 should + 原形。

drill.stem: ___ impressed me most were the amazing waterfalls in Jiuzhaigou.
drill.src: 2022 · 第五高中 · 高一上期中
drill.why: 主语从句里指物、作主语，句首大写。

topics.name: 强调句

explain.text: 强调状语
强调句的结构是 It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其余部分。被强调的是状语时，只用 that，其余部分保持原句语序，时态与原句一致。
判断：去掉 It is/was 和 that，句子仍然完整，就是强调句。原句里有 yesterday、in 2016 这样的时间或地点词，多半是被强调的对象。被强调的是人、并且作主语时，that 和 who 都可以；其余都用 that。
It was + 被强调部分 + that + 其余部分

topics.keypoint: 去掉 It is/was 和 that 后句子仍完整，就是强调句；被强调的是状语或宾语时，用 that。

stem.text: My grandpa walked the dog in the street [_yesterday_].
stem.src: 2024 · 光正实验 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: 我爷爷昨天在街上遛狗。

mid.label: 判断
mid.text: yesterday 是被强调的时间状语，原句一般过去时，用 It was … that。

examples.ans: It was yesterday that my grandpa walked the dog in the street

stem.text: I improved my oral English greatly [_because of the teacher’s encouragement_].
stem.src: 2023 · 东莞外国语 · 高一上月考

examples.ju: 正是因为老师的鼓励，我的英语口语才有了很大进步。

mid.label: 成分
mid.text: because of the teacher’s encouragement 是原因状语，放进 It was…that 中间。

examples.ans: It was because of the teacher’s encouragement that I improved my oral English greatly

drill.stem: He successfully started his own IT company [_with the encouragement of his family_].
drill.src: 2024 · 东莞市 · 高一上联考
drill.ans: It was with the encouragement of his family that he successfully started his own IT company.
drill.why: 状语强调只用 that，不用 who。

drill.stem: My teacher gives me encouragement [_when I meet with difficulties_].
drill.src: 2024 · 麻涌中学 · 高一上月考
drill.ans: It is when I meet with difficulties that my teacher gives me encouragement.
drill.why: 被强调的是 when 从句，结构不变。

drill.stem: In 2016, Coach Lang Ping led her volleyball team to Olympic gold [_in Brazil_].
cue: 改为强调地点状语的强调句
drill.src: 2024 · 第八高中 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It was in Brazil that Coach Lang Ping led her volleyball team to Olympic gold in 2016.
drill.why: 被强调的是地点状语 in Brazil。

drill.stem: She used [_the flash cards_] to teach the kids new words last class.
cue: 用强调句对划线部分强调
drill.src: 2025 · 东莞市 · 高一上期中
drill.ans: It was the flash cards that she used to teach the kids new words last class.
drill.why: 被强调的是宾语，用 that。

drill.stem: 正是他爱冒险的个性启发了他的朋友们尝试新鲜事物。
drill.src: 2024 · 东莞市 · 高一上月考
drill.ans: It was his adventurous/thrill-seeking personality that inspired/motivated/encouraged his friends to try new things/try something new.
drill.why: 强调主语，that 连接，结构同上。
